LeadershipPage.profilesDescription: Four investors from three nationalities bring decades of cross-border experience across business leadership, construction operations, project management, and workforce strategy.

devendra.name: Devendra Bajgai
devendra.role: Business Leadership, Workforce Systems & Risk Discipline
devendra.bio: Nepalese business leader with more than two decades of experience across business development, project management, security/risk management, international recruitment, and corporate governance. Executive Chairman of DD Security Service and Seven Seas Intercontinental Services.
devendra.contribution: Strategic business development, international recruitment networks, operational risk awareness, and owner-level governance.

shen.name: Shen Pu
shen.bio: Construction operations executive with more than twenty years of industry exposure spanning commercial management, real estate development, building materials supply, and construction contracting. Has operated Sinoshine Construction Company in Malaysia since 2017.
shen.contribution: Hands-on construction operations, project delivery management, building materials procurement, and commercial management.

deng.name: Deng Junhong
deng.bio: Corporate executive with established governance exposure in construction contracting. Listed as director of Sinoshine Construction Sdn Bhd, bringing practical corporate directorship, alliance governance, and strategic oversight.
deng.contribution: Construction-company directorship, corporate governance, partner coordination, and operational compliance.

tan.name: Tan Seok Hiang
tan.bio: Malaysian business and human-resources leader with over 15 years in workforce strategy and an Executive MBA. Director of Agensi Pekerjaan HR Assist Sdn. Bhd., leading workforce solutions, international relations, and operational efficiency.
tan.contribution: Workforce strategy, manpower planning and mobilisation, multinational client engagement, and operating partnerships.
